messages:
sasha: Quick review  proposing a 'Sable Slate' dark theme. Goals: softer blacks for long sessions, keep 12px monospace readable, and make charts understated on thumbnails. Thoughts?

sasha: rough tokens:
- --sable-900: #0a0b0d (canvas)
- --panel-800: #121316 (panels)
- --fg-primary: #e9eef2
- --fg-muted: #9fa8ae
- --accent-cool: #5fc2ff
- --accent-warm: #ffb77a

leo: Legend chips get lost on small thumbnails. Suggest adding `.chip { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.24); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04); padding: 4px 6px; border-radius:6px; }` to provide separation.

anya: quick contrast check: `#e9eef2` on `#0a0b0d` =~ 7.0:1 so fine. `#9fa8ae` on `#0a0b0d` =~ 3.4:1  reserve `--fg-muted` for microcopy only. Use `#cfd6db` for any secondary labels >12px.

brad: syntax palette suggestion (low-sat): keywords `#8fdcff`, strings `#ffd9a8`, functions `#cfbfff`, comments `#6f777d`. Avoid saturated greens that conflict with token heatmaps.

leo: charts: prefer tonal cascades vs saturated hues. Example series: `#5fc2ff`, `#7fb3d8`, `#9fc6e6`. Axis/gridlines: `--axis: rgba(255,255,255,0.05)` and `--grid: rgba(255,255,255,0.03)` for subtle separation.

a11y-bot: Storybook a11y check: muted token roles failing 4.5:1 for body text; recommended mapping: body>=4.5, label>=3.0. PRs should include token role annotations. Link: https://ci.redwood/a11y/4221

sasha: plan: leo wires chip bg and axis vars, anya adds the Storybook contrast test and updates PR template, brad will post deuteranopia/protanopia sims, quick 10-min sync tomorrow morning. :calendar:

leo: will prototype the toggle for "Contrast: Default / High" that swaps `--fg-muted` and raises grid alpha.

anya: I'll add the tests and the token-role doc.

brad: posting sims in #design-preview shortly.

sasha: thanks team  ping me if anyone spots legend collisions on small devices.
